component.name: SoundText
component.summary: Write music as text, then hear, arrange and mix it
Scrivi la musica come testo, poi ascoltala, arrangiala e mixala
Écrire la musique en texte, puis l'écouter, l'arranger et la mixer
Escribir música como texto, y luego escucharla, arreglarla y mezclarla

description.p: SoundText is a music editor where music is written as plain text: notes, chords, dynamics and form in a small notation language. The note being played lights up in the text, and the same song can be seen as a score.

ul.li: A notation checked bar by bar while you type, with patterns and transformations
An arranger that writes drums, bass and comping from a chord track
A structure view where each section of the song is a box of text
SoundFont and SFZ instruments, LV2, VST3 and CLAP plugins, NAM amplifier profiles
Audio tracks, and converting a recording into notation
Export to WAV, MIDI, MusicXML and PDF

description.p: Songs are plain text files in the open ST-language format, which also has a standalone Python library and command-line tools.

screenshot.caption: A song in the structure view, with the mixer

description.p: Audio Unit plugins and a ready-made app for macOS.
